title: BEiTScore++: Reference-free Image Captioning Evaluation with BEiT-3 and Conformalized Quantile Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.09505v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation is important for deploying evaluation metrics in real-world settings, where both input ambiguity and domain shifts are common. In this work, we propose an uncertainty-aware extension of the BEiTScore image captioning metric, producing conformally calibrated confidence intervals alongside alignment scores. Our approach models predictive distributions over human judgments, enabling both accurate scoring and principled uncertainty quantification in a single forward pass. We evaluate our BEiTScore++ metric across multiple benchmarks with human-annotated ratings, showing that it preserves the ranking correlation of BEiTScore, while producing intervals whose width tracks the prediction error more closely than Monte Carlo dropout on most benchmarks. The estimated uncertainty also grows under image degradation and on out-of-domain artwork images, making BEiTScore++ a practical tool for uncertainty-aware evaluati

translated_title: BEiTScore++：基于BEiT-3与共形化分位数回归的无参考图像描述评估
translated_abstract: 可靠的不确定性估计对于将评估指标部署到现实环境中至关重要，因为现实中输入歧义和领域偏移都很常见。在这项工作中，我们提出了BEiTScore图像描述评估指标的不确定性感知扩展版本，在对齐分数之外还能产生经过共形校准的置信区间。我们的方法对人类评判的预测分布进行建模，能够在单次前向传播中同时实现准确评分和有原则的不确定性量化。我们在多个带有人工标注评分的基准上评估了BEiTScore++指标，结果表明它保持了BEiTScore的排序相关性，同时在大多数基准上产生的区间宽度比蒙特卡洛dropout更贴近预测误差。估计的不确定性在图像退化条件下以及域外艺术图像上也会随之增大，这使得BEiTScore++成为一个实用的不确定性感知评估工具。
tldr: 提出BEiTScore++，通过共形化分位数回归为无参考图像描述评估指标引入共形校准的置信区间，在单次前向传播中同时实现准确评分与可靠的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: BEiTScore++ extends the reference-free image captioning metric BEiTScore with conformalized quantile regression, producing calibrated confidence intervals that enable accurate scoring and principled uncertainty quantification in a single forward pass.
